title: Social Media Manager - Paid & Organic Instagram
Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Overview** 




 Krishgen Biosystems is a leading distributor and manufacturer of life sciences reagents in India. Serving various industry segments such as drug discovery, pharma, biopharma, vaccines, cosmetics, CROs, and academia, Krishgen provides a wide range of products for research purposes.
 



  





 Website: https://krishgen.com/
 



  





**Job Title: Digital Marketing Specialist** 




  





**Role Description** 




 We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Digital Marketing Specialist to support end\-to\-end digital marketing activities. The role will involve content creation, social media management, paid digital campaigns, and email marketing execution. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with Canva, social media platforms, Google Ads, LinkedIn campaigns, and Email marketing tools.
 



 Job Location: Worli, Mumbai
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**Social Media Management** 



* Manage and maintain company social media platforms, primarily LinkedIn, and support other platforms as required.
* Plan, schedule, and publish posts in line with the monthly content calendar.
* Monitor engagement, comments, and basic analytics to assess post performance.
* Coordinate with internal teams for content inputs and approvals.



**Content Creation** 



* Design visually engaging creatives, carousels, and banners using Canva for social media, emailers, and digital campaigns.
* Ensure consistency with brand guidelines across all marketing materials.
* Support video edits, reels, or creatives when required.



**Paid Digital Marketing** 



* Assist in execution and monitoring of Google Ads.
* Support in ad copy creation, creative uploads, and audience targeting.
* Track campaign performance metrics and prepare reports.



**Email Marketing** 



* Create, schedule, and manage email marketing campaigns using Zoho Campaigns or similar platforms.
* Support list segmentation, database management, and email template design.
* Monitor email performance metrics and maintain campaign records.



**Marketing Operations \& Coordination** 



* Maintain content calendars, campaign trackers, and marketing documentation.
* Support marketing activities related to webinars, exhibitions and events.
* Assist in day\-to\-day marketing execution and coordination tasks.







**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or related scientific disciplines.
* Hands\-on experience with Canva for digital content creation.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms, especially LinkedIn \& Instagram.
* Basic understanding of Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and digital campaign metrics.
* Familiarity with Zoho Campaigns or similar email marketing tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to meet timelines.
